paragraphs.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
paragraphs.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ μὴ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τῶν προβάτων ἀλλὰ ἀναβαίνων ἀλλαχόθεν ἐκεῖνος κλέπτης ἐστὶν καὶ λῃστής·
paragraphs.translit: Amēn amēn legō hymin, ho mē eiserchomenos dia tēs thyras eis tēn aulēn tōn probatōn alla anabainōn allachothen ekeinos kleptēs estin kai lēstēs·

paragraphs.text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας ποιμήν ἐστιν τῶν προβάτων.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eiserchomenos dia tēs thyras poimēn estin tōn probatōn.

paragraphs.text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
paragraphs.original: τούτῳ ὁ θυρωρὸς ἀνοίγει, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούει καὶ τὰ ἴδια πρόβατα φωνεῖ κατʼ ὄνομα καὶ ἐξάγει αὐτά.
paragraphs.translit: toutō ho thyrōros anoigei, kai ta probata tēs phōnēs autou akouei kai ta idia probata phōnei katʼ onoma kai exagei auta.

paragraphs.text: When he hath put forth all his own, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
paragraphs.original: ὅταν τὰ ἴδια πάντα ἐκβάλῃ, ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν πορεύεται, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῷ ἀκολουθεῖ, ὅτι οἴδασιν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: hotan ta idia panta ekbalē, emprosthen autōn poreuetai, kai ta probata autō akolouthei, hoti oidasin tēn phōnēn autou·

paragraphs.text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλοτρίῳ δὲ οὐ μὴ ἀκολουθήσουσιν ἀλλὰ φεύξονται ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασι τῶν ἀλλοτρίων τὴν φωνήν.
paragraphs.translit: allotriō de ou mē akolouthēsousin alla pheuxontai apʼ autou, hoti ouk oidasi tōn allotriōn tēn phōnēn.

paragraphs.text: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
paragraphs.original: ταύτην τὴν παροιμίαν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τίνα ἦν ἃ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: tautēn tēn paroimian eipen autois ho Iēsous· ekeinoi de ouk egnōsan tina ēn ha elalei autois.

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore said unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
paragraphs.original: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα τῶν προβάτων.
paragraphs.translit: Eipen oun palin autois ho Iēsous· Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti egō eimi hē thyra tōn probatōn.

paragraphs.text: All that came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
paragraphs.original: πάντες ὅσοι ἦλθον πρὸ ἐμοῦ κλέπται εἰσὶν καὶ λῃσταί· ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἤκουσαν αὐτῶν τὰ πρόβατα.
paragraphs.translit: pantes hosoi ēlthon pro emou kleptai eisin kai lēstai· allʼ ouk ēkousan autōn ta probata.

paragraphs.text: I am the door; by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and go out, and shall find pasture.
paragraphs.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα· διʼ ἐμοῦ ἐάν τις εἰσέλθῃ σωθήσεται καὶ εἰσελεύσεται καὶ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ νομὴν εὑρήσει.
paragraphs.translit: egō eimi hē thyra· diʼ emou ean tis eiselthē sōthēsetai kai eiseleusetai kai exeleusetai kai nomēn heurēsei.

paragraphs.text: The thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I came that they may have life, and may have [it] abundantly.
paragraphs.original: ὁ κλέπτης οὐκ ἔρχεται εἰ μὴ ἵνα κλέψῃ καὶ θύσῃ καὶ ἀπολέσῃ· ἐγὼ ἦλθον ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχωσιν καὶ περισσὸν ἔχωσιν.
paragraphs.translit: ho kleptēs ouk erchetai ei mē hina klepsē kai thysē kai apolesē· egō ēlthon hina zōēn echōsin kai perisson echōsin.

paragraphs.text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.
paragraphs.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός· ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλὸς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ τίθησιν ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων·
paragraphs.translit: Egō eimi ho poimēn ho kalos· ho poimēn ho kalos tēn psychēn autou tithēsin hyper tōn probatōn·

paragraphs.text: He that is a hireling, and not a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, beholdeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth, and the wolf snatcheth them, and scattereth [them]:
paragraphs.original: ὁ μισθωτὸς καὶ οὐκ ὢν ποιμήν, οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν τὰ πρόβατα ἴδια, θεωρεῖ τὸν λύκον ἐρχόμενον καὶ ἀφίησιν τὰ πρόβατα καὶ φεύγει— καὶ ὁ λύκος ἁρπάζει αὐτὰ καὶ σκορπίζει—
paragraphs.translit: ho misthōtos kai ouk ōn poimēn, hou ouk estin ta probata idia, theōrei ton lykon erchomenon kai aphiēsin ta probata kai pheugei— kai ho lykos harpazei auta kai skorpizei—

paragraphs.text: [he fleeth] because he is a hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι μισθωτός ἐστιν καὶ οὐ μέλει αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν προβάτων.
paragraphs.translit: hoti misthōtos estin kai ou melei autō peri tōn probatōn.

paragraphs.text: I am the good shepherd; and I know mine own, and mine own know me,
paragraphs.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, καὶ γινώσκω τὰ ἐμὰ καὶ γινώσκουσί με τὰ ἐμά,
paragraphs.translit: egō eimi ho poimēn ho kalos, kai ginōskō ta ema kai ginōskousi me ta ema,

paragraphs.text: even as the Father knoweth me, and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.
paragraphs.original: καθὼς γινώσκει με ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ γινώσκω τὸν πατέρα, καὶ τὴν ψυχήν μου τίθημι ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων.
paragraphs.translit: kathōs ginōskei me ho patēr kagō ginōskō ton patera, kai tēn psychēn mou tithēmi hyper tōn probatōn.

paragraphs.text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice: and they shall become one flock, one shepherd.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἄλλα πρόβατα ἔχω ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς αὐλῆς ταύτης· κἀκεῖνα δεῖ με ἀγαγεῖν, καὶ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούσουσιν, καὶ γενήσονται μία ποίμνη, εἷς ποιμήν.
paragraphs.translit: kai alla probata echō ha ouk estin ek tēs aulēs tautēs· kakeina dei me agagein, kai tēs phōnēs mou akousousin, kai genēsontai mia poimnē, heis poimēn.

paragraphs.text: Therefore doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτό με ὁ πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ ὅτι ἐγὼ τίθημι τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἵνα πάλιν λάβω αὐτήν.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto me ho patēr agapa hoti egō tithēmi tēn psychēn mou, hina palin labō autēn.

paragraphs.text: No one taketh it away from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment received I from my Father.
paragraphs.original: οὐδεὶς αἴρει αὐτὴν ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ τίθημι αὐτὴν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ. ἐξουσίαν ἔχω θεῖναι αὐτήν, καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω πάλιν λαβεῖν αὐτήν· ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔλαβον παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου.
paragraphs.translit: oudeis airei autēn apʼ emou, allʼ egō tithēmi autēn apʼ emautou. exousian echō theinai autēn, kai exousian echō palin labein autēn· tautēn tēn entolēn elabon para tou patros mou.

paragraphs.text: There arose a division again among the Jews because of these words.
paragraphs.original: Σχίσμα πάλιν ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις διὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους.
paragraphs.translit: Schisma palin egeneto en tois Ioudaiois dia tous logous toutous.

paragraphs.text: And many of them said, He hath a demon, and is mad; why hear ye him?
paragraphs.original: ἔλεγον δὲ πολλοὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν· Δαιμόνιον ἔχει καὶ μαίνεται· τί αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε;
paragraphs.translit: elegon de polloi ex autōn· Daimonion echei kai mainetai· ti autou akouete;

paragraphs.text: Others said, These are not the sayings of one possessed with a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?
paragraphs.original: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα οὐκ ἔστιν δαιμονιζομένου· μὴ δαιμόνιον δύναται τυφλῶν ὀφθαλμοὺς ἀνοῖξαι;
paragraphs.translit: alloi elegon· Tauta ta rhēmata ouk estin daimonizomenou· mē daimonion dynatai typhlōn ophthalmous anoixai;

paragraphs.text: And it was the feast of the dedication at Jerusalem:
paragraphs.original: Ἐγένετο τότε τὰ ἐγκαίνια ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις· χειμὼν ἦν,
paragraphs.translit: Egeneto tote ta enkainia en tois Hierosolymois· cheimōn ēn,

paragraphs.text: it was winter; and Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon`s porch.
paragraphs.original: καὶ περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐν τῇ στοᾷ τοῦ Σολομῶνος.
paragraphs.translit: kai periepatei ho Iēsous en tō hierō en tē stoa tou Solomōnos.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore came round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou hold us in suspense? If thou art the Christ, tell us plainly.
paragraphs.original: ἐκύκλωσαν οὖν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ· Ἕως πότε τὴν ψυχὴν ἡμῶν αἴρεις; εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστός, εἰπὲ ἡμῖν παρρησίᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: ekyklōsan oun auton hoi Ioudaioi kai elegon autō· Heōs pote tēn psychēn hēmōn aireis; ei sy ei ho christos, eipe hēmin parrēsia.

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believe not: the works that I do in my Father`s name, these bear witness of me.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε· τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρός μου ταῦτα μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē autois ho Iēsous· Eipon hymin kai ou pisteuete· ta erga ha egō poiō en tō onomati tou patros mou tauta martyrei peri emou·

paragraphs.text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε, ὅτι οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων τῶν ἐμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: alla hymeis ou pisteuete, hoti ouk este ek tōn probatōn tōn emōn.

paragraphs.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
paragraphs.original: τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἐμὰ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούουσιν, κἀγὼ γινώσκω αὐτά, καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσίν μοι,
paragraphs.translit: ta probata ta ema tēs phōnēs mou akouousin, kagō ginōskō auta, kai akolouthousin moi,

paragraphs.text: and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.
paragraphs.original: κἀγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπόλωνται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ οὐχ ἁρπάσει τις αὐτὰ ἐκ τῆς χειρός μου.
paragraphs.translit: kagō didōmi autois zōēn aiōnion, kai ou mē apolōntai eis ton aiōna, kai ouch harpasei tis auta ek tēs cheiros mou.

paragraphs.text: My Father, who hath given [them] unto me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch [them] out of the Father`s hand.
paragraphs.original: ὁ πατήρ μου ὃ δέδωκέν μοι πάντων μεῖζων ἐστίν, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἁρπάζειν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ πατρός.
paragraphs.translit: ho patēr mou ho dedōken moi pantōn meizōn estin, kai oudeis dynatai harpazein ek tēs cheiros tou patros.

paragraphs.text: I and the Father are one.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἕν ἐσμεν.
paragraphs.translit: egō kai ho patēr hen esmen.

paragraphs.text: The Jews took up stones again to stone him.
paragraphs.original: Ἐβάστασαν οὖν πάλιν λίθους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα λιθάσωσιν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: Ebastasan oun palin lithous hoi Ioudaioi hina lithasōsin auton.

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I showed you from the Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πολλὰ ἔργα καλὰ ἔδειξα ὑμῖν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός· διὰ ποῖον αὐτῶν ἔργον ἐμὲ λιθάζετε;
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē autois ho Iēsous· Polla erga kala edeixa hymin ek tou patros· dia poion autōn ergon eme lithazete;

paragraphs.text: The Jews answered him, For a good work we stone thee not, but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Περὶ καλοῦ ἔργου οὐ λιθάζομέν σε ἀλλὰ περὶ βλασφημίας, καὶ ὅτι σὺ ἄνθρωπος ὢν ποιεῖς σεαυτὸν θεόν.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithēsan autō hoi Ioudaioi· Peri kalou ergou ou lithazomen se alla peri blasphēmias, kai hoti sy anthrōpos ōn poieis seauton theon.

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, ye are gods?
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὑμῶν ὅτι Ἐγὼ εἶπα· Θεοί ἐστε;
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē autois ho Iēsous· Ouk estin gegrammenon en tō nomō hymōn hoti Egō eipa· Theoi este;

paragraphs.text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came (and the scripture cannot be broken),
paragraphs.original: εἰ ἐκείνους εἶπεν θεοὺς πρὸς οὓς ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ οὐ δύναται λυθῆναι ἡ γραφή,
paragraphs.translit: ei ekeinous eipen theous pros hous ho logos tou theou egeneto, kai ou dynatai lythēnai hē graphē,

paragraphs.text: say ye of him, whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am [the] Son of God?
paragraphs.original: ὃν ὁ πατὴρ ἡγίασεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Βλασφημεῖς, ὅτι εἶπον· Υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ εἰμι;
paragraphs.translit: hon ho patēr hēgiasen kai apesteilen eis ton kosmon hymeis legete hoti Blasphēmeis, hoti eipon· Hyios tou theou eimi;

paragraphs.text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
paragraphs.original: εἰ οὐ ποιῶ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρός μου, μὴ πιστεύετέ μοι·
paragraphs.translit: ei ou poiō ta erga tou patros mou, mē pisteuete moi·

paragraphs.text: But if I do them, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ ποιῶ, κἂν ἐμοὶ μὴ πιστεύητε τοῖς ἔργοις πιστεύετε, ἵνα γνῶτε καὶ γινώσκητε ὅτι ἐν ἐμοὶ ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρί.
paragraphs.translit: ei de poiō, kan emoi mē pisteuēte tois ergois pisteuete, hina gnōte kai ginōskēte hoti en emoi ho patēr kagō en tō patri.

paragraphs.text: They sought again to take him: and he went forth out of their hand.
paragraphs.original: ἐζήτουν οὖν πάλιν αὐτὸν πιάσαι· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ezētoun oun palin auton piasai· kai exēlthen ek tēs cheiros autōn.

paragraphs.text: And he went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was at the first baptizing; and there be abode.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἦν Ἰωάννης τὸ πρῶτον βαπτίζων, καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai apēlthen palin peran tou Iordanou eis ton topon hopou ēn Iōannēs to prōton baptizōn, kai emeinen ekei.

paragraphs.text: And many came unto him; and they said, John indeed did no sign: but all things whatsoever John spake of this man were true.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν σημεῖον ἐποίησεν οὐδέν, πάντα δὲ ὅσα εἶπεν Ἰωάννης περὶ τούτου ἀληθῆ ἦν.
paragraphs.translit: kai polloi ēlthon pros auton kai elegon hoti Iōannēs men sēmeion epoiēsen ouden, panta de hosa eipen Iōannēs peri toutou alēthē ēn.

paragraphs.text: And many believed on him there.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: kai polloi episteusan eis auton ekei.
